prompt:
Create one 2×2 pixel-art horizontal-gaze atlas from the single supplied reference grid. The reference shows the selected NPC091 HAPPY OPEN eyes in the top row and selected HAPPY HALF phase in the bottom row. Output four equal, aligned, complete 64×35 upper-face cells in row-major order: LEFT OPEN, RIGHT OPEN / LEFT HALF, RIGHT HALF. Preserve exact crop framing, hair, forehead, brows, expression, eye spacing, eyelid contours, iris size, and source pixel style.

Both eyes must track together toward the same image side. In both LEFT cells, shift each compact iris and pupil about one native pixel toward image-left. In both RIGHT cells, shift both about one native pixel toward image-right. Keep natural source convergence and nearly equal movement. Do not leave one eye centered, move either eye toward the nose, or make the gaze cross-eyed. Keep the eyes warm and friendly, but preserve the selected happy smile-eye anatomy.

Keep dark pupil and colored iris clusters compact and the same native size, with muted source highlights. Do not change pupil height, widen the aperture, add broad white or cream bands, enlarge the eyes, or add bright glints. Bottom-row HALF cells must retain the selected half-closed aperture. Keep each iris and pupil at the same x/y position as its corresponding OPEN gaze; the upper lid covers the top of each iris while leaving the dark pupil and part of the iris recognizable. Do not move lower lids, brows, hair, cheeks, or face. No extra details, labels, text, border, watermark, or transparency.
